source_network: controllable localhost HTTP fixture; source server stopped for reparse
isolation: fresh PostgreSQL database and S3 bucket per invocation

boundaries.failure: due-resource count is mistaken for HTTP request count
boundaries.assertion: three or more due Resources rechecked using fewer real external requests, singleton final batch succeeds, request and document budgets remain separate

boundaries.failure: resource without public_url cannot be rechecked or projected
boundaries.assertion: stable namespace/external_key and recheck_locator suffice; metadata URL is nullable

boundaries.failure: reparse performs source request, mutates old Run parser, fabricates Acquisition, or fails to recompute Version
boundaries.assertion: new explicit Run freezes CAS inputs and parser; zero source network/new Acquisition; old Run/Version/Snapshot fixed; new Version explained and readable through results/files

boundaries.failure: CAS originals are archived but undiscovered targets are lost on takeover
boundaries.assertion: worker resumes from archived originals and registers every target exactly once

boundaries.failure: partially delivered batch or volume creates omissions or duplicate Versions
boundaries.assertion: takeover skips completed targets and completes remaining targets

boundaries.failure: successful targets repeat when checkpoint was not advanced
boundaries.assertion: replay is idempotent; checkpoint advances once

boundaries.failure: expired attempt writes acquisitions, targets, deliveries, or cursor
boundaries.assertion: stale owner writes rejected after takeover

boundaries.failure: same delivery key accepts changed inputs/parser/content or same inputs/parser produce different business output
boundaries.assertion: repeat is idempotent, associations may append, conflicts explicit and immutable successful lineage preserved

boundaries.failure: shared batch reorder or irrelevant sibling changes churn single document Version
boundaries.assertion: unrelated changes stable; relevant encoding/base/date/volume/required-attachment changes have correct version behavior

boundaries.failure: cancellation, request budget, network, parse/quality, missing required attachments, incomplete enumeration are conflated
boundaries.assertion: coverage identifies each class, unknown denominator remains UNKNOWN, Snapshot freezes conclusions

boundaries.failure: current Run, cancelled/failed acquisition, B publication, or corrupt CAS contaminates fixed A
boundaries.assertion: A cursor stays fixed while B is published; A rows/coverage/files remain immutable; corrupt CAS is refused by files API

boundaries.failure: results projections or downloadable bytes disagree with the selected immutable Snapshot
boundaries.assertion: exact 16 business keys per item reconcile with Snapshot delivery rows; every authorized file closure hash is fetched through files API and byte-matches CAS, Content-Length and ETag; no cancelled capability is invoked

scope: API-only after user cancelled all issue32 delivery capability; cancelled scenarios are excluded from outcomes
